scope: Minimal native Cubical boundary between a strict classifier and a partial classifier definable only up to weak bisimilarity: on the quotient A/R_A (a~b), no strict Delay-valued function extends P0 (C-120); the strict Bool consumer cannot descend either (C-122); P0 descends to a partial classifier Q -> Delay Bool / R_D (C-121); the representative-level strict classifier exists and separates a,b (C-118, C-119, C-123). Boundary result with positive control; not a HoTT paradox.
